name: NEXT_{dist}_km_WHITE_WIDE
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R6-SA105A (1200 x 370) illustrated (AA 900 x 280, B 1440 x 450, C 1800 x 560), 2015, 1:10; R50, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). One line, centred ('=' margins): NEXT 140 D (ink 423), 105 gap, distance numerals 140 D ('Varies', dashed box), 70 gap, km 120 D lower case (ink 210); baseline 255 (top 115, 115 below). km is drawn from the FHWA Series D lower case at cap height 120. The sheet gives no example distance: generated at 1, 2, 3, 5 and 10 km (choose the values SA uses under R6-22 — not confirmed). Mounted below R6-22.
